resetIntro: We got a request to reset the password for your FreehandCV account. Open the link below to set a new one.
resetExpiry: {hours, plural, one {The link works for # hour} other {The link works for # hours}} and can be used only once.
resetIgnore: If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.
linkFallback: If the button doesn’t work, paste this address into your browser:
verifyIntro: Thanks for creating a FreehandCV account. Verify your email address to open it.
verifyExpiry: {hours, plural, one {The link works for # hour} other {The link works for # hours}}. If it expires, we send a new one when you try to sign in.
verifyIgnore: If you didn’t create this account, you can ignore this email; an unverified account can’t be used.
existingSubject: You already have a FreehandCV account
existingIntro: Someone tried to create a new FreehandCV account with this email address. You already have an account with it, so you can just sign in.
existingReset: If you don’t remember your password, set a new one here: {url}
existingIgnore: If this wasn’t you, there’s nothing to do; your account hasn’t changed.
changeIntro: We got a request to change your FreehandCV account’s email address to {email}. If you approve, we send a verification link to the new address; the address changes when that link is clicked.
changeIgnore: If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this email and change your password; your address stays the same.
newEmailSubject: Verify your new FreehandCV email address
newEmailIntro: Verify this address to make it your FreehandCV account’s new email. Once verified, you sign in with it.
newEmailIgnore: If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email; no account moves to this address.
